indices.standing_risk_en: 🎲 Standing daily risk: 0.77%/day. This is a MARKET-IMPLIED probability — real money on Polymarket — not a forecast by this page and not a sensor reading. It comes from one open contract, "Israel x Iran ceasefire continues through December 31?", which resolves on an air or missile strike by either side against the other: its price implies a 22% chance of such a strike before 2026-12-31, with 33 days left to run. The figure published is the PER-DAY rate, not the contract price: a contract price falls on its own as expiry approaches even when nothing has changed, so only the daily rate is comparable from one week to the next. Casts no vote.

weather.disclaimer_he: מידע בלבד — לא סמן. בדיקה לאחור של 6 אירועים (2024-2026) לא מצאה קשר בין עננות לתקיפות; בהיר אינו מעיד על סיכון.
weather.disclaimer_en: Information only — not an indicator. A backtest of 6 events (2024–2026) found no link between cloud cover and strikes; clear skies do not indicate risk.
weather.note_he: תחזית עננות כוללת ל-12 השעות הקרובות (Open-Meteo), ממוצע על הנקודות. בהיר: עד 20%, חלקי: 20-70%, מעונן: מעל 70%. "בעונה זו" = חלק החלונות של 12 שעות שהתחילו באותה שעה ובאותה עונה (±30 יום) ב-2020-2025 (ERA5) והיו באותה קטגוריה. אינו נכנס לרמה, לספירה או להתראות.
weather.note_en: Total cloud-cover forecast for the next 12 hours (Open-Meteo), averaged over the points. Clear: up to 20%, partly: 20–70%, cloudy: above 70%. "This season" = the share of 12-hour windows starting at the same hour and season (±30 days) of 2020–2025 (ERA5) that fell in the same category. It does not enter the level, the counts or any alert.
